title: fakewhats Conversation

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL, for editor autocomplete.

name.description: Contact or business name shown in the header.

avatar.description: Avatar image URL. If omitted, a default silhouette is shown.

status.description: Subtitle under the name, e.g. "online", "typing...", "last seen today at 10:00".

verified.description: Shows the green verified badge next to the name.

story.description: Status (story) ring around the avatar: "new" = green ring, "seen" = grey ring.

business.description: Business chat header: iOS shows a single call button with a menu arrow instead of the contact/video/call buttons.

from.description: "me" = outgoing (right side, green bubble). "them" = the contact (left side).

time.description: Time shown inside the bubble, e.g. "10:42" or "9:05 PM".

status.description: Delivery ticks for outgoing messages: pending = clock, sent = one grey tick, delivered = two grey ticks, read = two blue ticks. Ignored on incoming messages.

reply.description: Shows a quoted message at the top of the bubble.

author.description: Name shown on the quote, e.g. "You" or the contact name.

text.description: Quoted text, e.g. "Photo" when quoting an image.

image.description: Thumbnail of the quoted photo, shown on the right of the quote (with a camera icon before the text).

reactions.description: Emoji reactions shown under the bubble, e.g. ["❤️", "😂"].

edited.description: Shows the "Edited" label next to the time.

starred.description: Shows a star next to the time.

share.description: Shows the round forward/share button next to the bubble (WhatsApp shows it on links and media).

type.description: Optional. Messages without a type are text.

text.description: Message text. Supports WhatsApp formatting: *bold*, _italic_, ~strike~, `inline code`, ```monospace```, and links. Use \n for line breaks.

title.description: Bold first line, usually the page title or the domain, e.g. "example.com".

description.description: Grey text under the title (up to 2 lines), e.g. the full URL.

domain.description: Domain shown with a link icon at the bottom, e.g. "example.com".

image.description: Optional thumbnail URL shown on top of the card.

preview.description: Link preview card drawn at the top of the bubble.

sections.description: List options. Only rendered when `open` is true.

open.description: If true, renders the options sheet open over the chat (only one list should be open).

selected.description: Title of the row shown as selected when the sheet is open.

text.description: Centered yellow notice, e.g. the encryption notice or "This chat is with a business account."

pinned.description: Pinned message bar under the header.

total.description: How many messages are pinned (1 to 3). Draws that many marks on the left. Default 1.

draft.description: Text typed in the input bar. When set, the send button replaces the mic.

scrollButton.description: Shows the round "scroll to latest message" button above the input bar.

unreadCount.description: Unread number shown next to the back arrow.
